stories.title: Shubman Gill fronts Tata Capital
stories.summary: Tata Capital has launched a public awareness campaign featuring cricketer Shubman Gill as Inspector Gill. The films urge borrowers to understand loan terms before committing, a move intended to promote responsible borrowing as digital applications and instant approvals make credit access faster for consumers.

stories.title: GAP launches Give Your Gift campaign for holiday season
stories.summary: GAP has launched its Give Your Gift holiday campaign, featuring a performance of the Jackson 5 song I'll Be There by three choirs. The campaign continues the company's multi-year platform focused on individuality and community, extending across new channels to inspire connection this season.

stories.title: Dabur Honitus gets Himesh Reshammiya to tackle seasonal coughs
stories.summary: Dabur Honitus has launched a digital campaign titled Khansi Ka Kaam Tamaam, featuring singer Himesh Reshammiya. The initiative uses the singer's initials as a creative hook and includes a partnership with Blinkit to make the brand's cough relief products available through quick-commerce.

stories.title: Max India subsidiary Antara launches AGEasy campaign with Anupam Kher
stories.summary: Antara Senior Care has launched a digital campaign for its AGEasy brand featuring actor Anupam Kher. The initiative promotes knee support and pillow products while aiming to challenge stereotypes about aging. The brand has touched over 9 lakh lives since its 2023 inception.

stories.title: Bhima Gold launches bridal jewellery campaign featuring Janhvi Kapoor
stories.summary: Bhima Gold has launched a bridal jewellery campaign featuring actor Janhvi Kapoor. The campaign focuses on how contemporary brides incorporate family traditions into their weddings while maintaining personal identities. It positions bridal jewellery as a keepsake intended to be passed down through generations.

stories.title: Finland's Posti launches North Pole Redirect campaign to correct Santa Claus' mailing address
stories.summary: Finland's postal service has launched a campaign to redirect letters for Santa Claus to Rovaniemi, his official hometown. The city holds a registered trademark for the title, which the EU Intellectual Property Office upheld earlier this year. The North Pole remains a popular, if incorrect, destination.

stories.title: Traya's new campaign with Rajkummar Rao focuses on hair growth results
stories.summary: Traya Health has introduced the next phase of its Proof Hai Boss campaign featuring actor Rajkummar Rao. The initiative highlights customer transformation stories to promote the brand's hair growth treatments. The company aims to reach 100 million people through digital platforms during November.

stories.title: Jemimah Rodrigues joins Smriti Mandhana as Hero MotoCorp brand ambassador
stories.summary: Hero MotoCorp has appointed cricketer Jemimah Rodrigues as a brand ambassador for its VIDA mobility brand. The company says the move reinforces its commitment to youth empowerment and women's sports, following the appointment of Smriti Mandhana to the same role earlier this year.

stories.title: Anblick Media secures digital and creative mandate for Sixit
stories.summary: Anblick Media has been appointed to manage digital and creative responsibilities for the sporting-goods brand Sixit. The agency will focus on brand communication and digital engagement. Sixit recently appointed cricketer Arshdeep Singh as a brand ambassador to increase visibility among players and supporters.

stories.title: Simca Advertising wins Rs 41.30 crore hoarding rights from Indian Railways' Mumbai CST Division - BMI
BigTrunk Communications wins DBM Store digital mandate
stories.summary: BigTrunk Communications has secured the digital marketing mandate for DBM Store, the e-commerce platform of Danube Building Materials. The agency will oversee digital strategy and creative storytelling to target trade professionals and homeowners, leveraging the brand's 30-year legacy in the building materials sector.

stories.title: Anblick Media wins digital and creative mandate for Mahesh Value Products brand SiXiT
stories.summary: Mahesh Value Products has appointed Anblick Media to manage the digital and creative mandate for its sporting-goods brand SiXiT. The agency will handle social media management, content development and digital advertising to build a consistent presence for the brand.

stories.title: Infectious Advertising appoints two creative directors
stories.summary: Infectious Advertising has appointed Sumit Bansode as creative director for art and Harish Nair as creative director for copy. Both hires bring over a decade of experience in digital advertising, having previously worked with agencies including Dentsu and Ogilvy on various automotive and financial brands.

stories.title: Arvind Gupta moves from WPP Media to INNOCEAN India - BMI
Nike India raises ad spends 11% to Rs 52.84 Cr
stories.summary: Nike India increased its advertising and promotional expenditure to Rs 52.84 crore in the financial year ended March 2025. The company reported revenue from operations of Rs 1,344.11 crore, a 13.94% increase over the previous year, alongside the rise in marketing spend.

stories.title: WPP adds Meta to Open line-up
stories.summary: WPP has announced a deal to pilot a new creative solution from Meta within its WPP Open platform. The agency group, which previously struck a $400 million deal with Google, is testing the tool to navigate creative strategy and optimisation for its clients.

stories.title: Bombay HC denies Blink Digital’s plea to restore Meta ad accounts
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court has declined to restore four advertising accounts belonging to Blink Digital that were disabled by Meta in August 2026. The court directed the agency to approach Meta again for reinstatement, noting that the agency had not established grounds for an immediate injunction.

stories.title: Creator economy forecast to reach $116 billion
stories.summary: The creator economy is projected to hit $116 billion as brands increase their spending. India is forecast to see the fastest growth in 2026 at 20 percent, outpacing the global average of 15 percent. Spending is moving in one direction.

stories.title: Gleb Savchenko launches OnlyFans account
stories.summary: Gleb Savchenko, a professional dancer on Dancing With the Stars since 2013, launched an OnlyFans account in November 2026. The move follows his exclusion from the show's Season 35 lineup. The pivot is described as a way to diversify income and build a direct audience.

stories.title: Influencer Neha Bisht's fan allegedly demands marriage, dies after assault - Buzzincontent
Grand Theft Auto VI launch sets streaming records
stories.summary: Rockstar Games partnered with creators to promote Grand Theft Auto VI, which Twitch described as the biggest game launch ever. The marketing effort followed 13 years of development. The game arrived with a new setting to help streamers manage licensed music.

stories.title: Comedian brand partnership fees vary widely in India
stories.summary: Indian comedians command partnership fees ranging from 1 lakh to upwards of 75 lakh rupees. Rates depend on audience reach and the nature of the association, with no standard rate card in place. Comedians are currently being priced by the project.

stories.title: Cashify shifts marketing budget toward YouTube
stories.summary: Cashify is allocating 20 percent of its marketing budget to YouTube to support creator-led content. The company is expanding partnerships into regional markets as it reports a turnaround in financial performance, posting a consolidated net profit of 6.49 crore rupees for fiscal year 2026.

stories.title: GTA VI music muting feature fails to stop all copyright claims
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI includes a setting to mute licensed music to help streamers avoid copyright claims. Despite the feature, some tracks may still trigger issues for creators. The game is the first in the series to offer an automated solution for streaming.

stories.title: e.l.f. Beauty acquires Rhode for up to $1 billion
stories.summary: e.l.f. Beauty acquired Hailey Bieber's skincare brand Rhode for up to $1 billion. The deal included $800 million at closing and $200 million in potential earnouts. Rhode reported $390 million in net sales for fiscal year 2026. The price was agreed upon in May 2025.

stories.title: BB Tamil 8 Winner Muthukumaran Booked After Influencer Alleges He Promised Marriage Before Sexual Relations - News18
Nexxen and Gracenote integrate CTV targeting data
stories.summary: Nexxen has partnered with Gracenote to bring program-level targeting to connected TV advertising. The integration allows brands to plan campaigns using specific content insights rather than broad audience data. Advertisers are seeking more visibility into where their ads appear.

stories.title: BADBOX 3.0 ad fraud scheme generates 40 billion daily requests
stories.summary: HUMAN Security says it disrupted an ad fraud operation called BADBOX 3.0 that generated 40 billion fraudulent requests daily. The scheme used compromised Android TV boxes to impersonate streaming apps. The network accounted for 4 percent of observed connected TV traffic.

stories.title: Brands increase holiday digital media spending
stories.summary: Brands are expected to spend 10 to 30 percent more on digital media for Black Friday and Cyber Monday compared to 2025. Retail media, search, and connected TV are primary targets for the increased budgets. Last year, 33,000 U.S. brands spent $607 million during the period.

stories.title: X updates video tools for creators
stories.summary: X is adding new video thumbnail and caption options to its platform. The company continues to release tools intended to encourage more video uploads from its user base.

stories.title: YouTube adds co-view counts to CTV metrics
stories.summary: YouTube is updating its connected TV metrics to include co-view counts based on television industry standards. The platform will apply these new calculations across its ad formats moving forward.

stories.title: TikTok announces AI and safety updates
stories.summary: TikTok announced new transparency features and parental controls at its third Safety and Innovation Summit. The updates are intended to provide additional protections for creators and teen users on the platform.

stories.title: YouTube tests music generation for creators
stories.summary: YouTube is testing a tool that allows creators to generate royalty-free instrumental tracks to replace copyrighted audio in videos. The platform is also testing bulk comment moderation options for channel managers. The music feature is currently limited to United States desktop users.

stories.title: YouTube Shorts algorithm shifts to prioritize original content
stories.summary: YouTube updated its Shorts recommendation system on October 1 to prioritize original content. The change reduces the reach of aggregator channels that re-upload clips with minimal modifications. The platform is shifting algorithmic weight toward creators who produce their own material.

stories.title: Meta narrows 2026 capital expenditure to $145 billion
stories.summary: Meta Platforms narrowed its 2026 capital expenditure guidance to between $135 billion and $145 billion. The majority of the spending is allocated to artificial intelligence infrastructure. The company continues to bet that AI will sustain its advertising growth.

stories.title: SOCi launches MCP server to integrate brand data
stories.summary: SOCi has launched a Model Context Protocol server to connect its agentic workforce with over 140 external systems. The company describes its context layer as a unified source of truth for brand knowledge, guiding more than 400,000 Genius Agents. The agents now have more places to look.

stories.title: AWS Quick adds Meta ads management to AI workspace
stories.summary: AWS Quick has introduced a Meta ads connector allowing users to analyze campaigns and edit settings using natural language instructions. The update aims to move beyond simple AI-generated recommendations by enabling direct campaign modifications. Marketers are now invited to delegate their advertising operations to the workspace.

stories.title: Capture card market shifts toward mainstream consumer use
stories.summary: The global capture card market is transitioning from a niche PC component to a mainstream consumer accessory, according to IndexBox. The market is bifurcating into high-volume commoditized segments and premium feature-differentiated products. Demand fundamentals are reportedly broader as the industry enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement behavior.

stories.title: Hootsuite integrates Meta ads into conversational workflow
stories.summary: Hootsuite has introduced a conversational workflow for Meta ads, allowing users to pull reports and edit campaigns through its AI, Wisdom. The platform promises a simpler way to move from insight to in-market action. Users are encouraged to review changes before they are officially launched.

stories.title: AWS Quick Meta ads connector enables campaign writes
stories.summary: AWS Quick has added a Meta ads connector that supports campaign creation, management, and analysis. The tool allows advertisers to use natural language to modify accounts, provided they authorize the changes. The company notes a tension between preparing a recommendation and accepting responsibility for the resulting action.

stories.title: AWS Quick adds Meta ads data integration
stories.summary: AWS Quick now allows marketers to connect Meta ads data with inventory and customer information stored in data lakes. The company suggests that manual spreadsheet merging and campaign updates are slow and prone to data aging. The platform aims to bridge the gap between insight and action.

stories.title: YouTube expands automatic AI dubbing for all users
stories.summary: YouTube has rolled out automatic dubbing to all users, using AI to translate and voice audio tracks. The feature is intended to remove language barriers for viewers. Some users may be hearing these AI-generated voice-overs without realizing the source of the audio.

stories.title: Top MarTech News From the Week of November 20th: Updates from Bloomreach, SurveyMonkey, Panopto, and More - Solutions Re
Outreach brings revenue data to ChatGPT
stories.summary: Outreach has launched Outreach Skills for ChatGPT, allowing revenue teams to access data and workflows directly within the chatbot. The company is also expanding its Connector Suite for the Model Context Protocol. Revenue teams are encouraged to act on their data wherever they happen to be working.
